profile_text.body:
Luma AI is a Palo Alto-based company that describes itself as a creative AI platform focused on video generation and image creation. The company says its platform is powered by two video generation models, Ray and Uni, alongside creative agents designed to handle end-to-end workflows. It describes its offering as trusted by leading agencies and brands and available to try for free.

The company highlights Uni-1 as a model oriented toward brand intelligence, describing it as capable of understanding a brand's style references, character references, and visual grounding and carrying those elements into generated assets. Luma AI has also announced a collaboration with Wonder Project called Luma Launch, described as a production services company combining generative AI with traditional filmmaking.

The site's held facts list Luma AI's primary product in the video generation and editing category, with a focus on 3D and video generation. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
